note.zh: 世界议会之后的阶段要么取得突破（25 击退入侵者），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败（30 荒废）。
note.en: After the World Council the stage either breaks through (25, the Invaders are repelled) or fails on a roll, with a base 1.5% chance per roll (30, Devastation).

note.zh: 探索结束，获得大量星界丝缕与凝聚力；360 天后收到怪异通讯（50）。
note.en: The exploration ends with a large astral thread and unity reward; 360 days later a strange transmission arrives (50).

label.zh: 击退入侵者：带回一位领袖

note.zh: 选择一位裂隙扭曲的科学官、指挥官或行政官；随后探索结束，立即触发“先祖之魂”（40），360 天后收到怪异通讯（50）。
note.en: Choose a Rift Warped scientist, commander or official; the exploration then ends, Spirit of our Ancestors (40) follows at once and a strange transmission (50) 360 days later.

note.zh: 失败分支：选择带走难民、接受贵族（获得一名行政官）或保存/索取档案；探索结束，随后“先祖之魂”（40）与 360 天后的怪异通讯（50）。
note.en: Failure branch: take refugees, accept the noble's offer (an official leader) or preserve/claim the library; the exploration ends, then Spirit of our Ancestors (40) and, 360 days later, the strange transmission (50).

note.zh: 来自裂隙彼端的声音称“很快会找到你们”后中断；这段通讯没有后续选项。
note.en: The voice from beyond the rifts says it will soon find the empire, then falls silent; the transmission has no further options.

notes.zh: 这道裂隙不在随机裂隙池中（randomized = no），只由“裂隙世界”起源在开局时于母星系生成，并附带一座研究站。
notes.en: This rift is not in the random pool (randomized = no); only the Riftworld origin creates it at game start in the home system, together with a research station.

notes.zh: 此处的选择决定先见星光先锋（10）还是黑幕派（15）。在先访问的一派处可以改去另一派一次（10.c / 15.c）；到第二派时只能给予援助或放弃（10.d / 15.d）。灭绝主义帝国不能选黑幕派，且在星光先锋处也不能改道。
notes.en: This choice decides whether the Starlight Vanguard (10) or the Black Curtain (15) is visited first. From the first faction the player may switch once (10.c / 15.c); at the second faction only aid or abandonment remain (10.d / 15.d). Exterminator empires cannot pick the Black Curtain and cannot switch from the Vanguard.

notes.zh: 标题中的派系名由脚本决定：一般为“星光先锋”，灭绝主义帝国为“星光征服者”。
notes.en: The faction name in the title is scripted: “Starlight Vanguard”, or “Starlight Vanquishers” for exterminator empires.

notes.zh: 原文差异：英文说裂隙这一侧的探球发射“不到五十年前”，中文译作“短短的15年后”。
notes.en: Localisation difference: English says the Sphere was launched “less than fifty years ago” on this side of the rift; the Chinese text says “15 years later”.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义、生成来源（裂隙世界起源）、1–57 全部事件、失败分支 30 与 360 天后的通讯链；失败事件 30 已并入本篇。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition, its origin spawn, every event 1–57, failure branch 30 and the 360-day transmission chain; failure event 30 is now part of this story.

uncertain: Text variants keyed by description_* rift flags (gestalt, machine, hive, lithoid/synthetic, arc-site completed) are shown as unresolved conditions by the V4 condition model.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现另一个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other system appears here.
